metadata.title: Live Work Item view
metadata.description: Puts the live view at the top of a Work Item page: the stages as folds, one sentence on what the agent is doing, and the flight path where every Run is a hop whose height follows its tool calls, machine failures bounce back, a stalled Run holds and tripwires and a judge's verdicts are marked. Below it, questions answered from the record. Takes the place of the four-stage strip and the flight profile. It cannot be on together with Unified Work Item page, which replaces the whole page: turning one on turns the other off.

metadata.title: Unified Work Item page
metadata.description: One page for a Work Item and the session that started it. Where it stands and what waits on you first, the flight on a dark ground, then a log of everything that happened with clock times and the spend tape, where every Run opens in place to what the agent did and its pod logs. A Work Item started in Unfold also carries its session there: its questions and permission requests, Pause, Resume and Cancel, its evidence (activity, gateway calls, changes, checks and hand-off) and budget. A session link opens its Work Item; the pull request is the one review. The intent bar steers, asks or adds context and says who reads it before you send. Acceptance proof is not reported by Ploeg yet, so conditions say so. It cannot be on together with Live Work Item view, which it replaces: turning one on turns the other off.

metadata.title: Fleet board on Now
metadata.description: Adds a Desk and Fleet switch to Now. Fleet shows every Team you can read at once: a headline over the whole fleet, totals, an airspace where each Team is a lane and each Work Item a plane from the gate through in the air, holding and on approach to landed, with the Team's last Runs as a contrail, and departures and arrivals boards of running, queued and finished Runs. Built from the same Now and 24-hour summary reads as the desk; nothing is estimated.

metadata.title: The loop on Now
metadata.description: Lays Now out in the order you work it. One line says how many things need you (the same number as the Now badge), split into to decide, stuck and could not start, with what runs and what was spent today. It turns amber only when that got worse since your last visit. Then Decide (pull requests and proposals only you can accept), Unstick (what Ploeg stopped on, each with its last failed Run and Try again in place, then the tasks it refused) and Up next (the next five open tasks of the boards Ploeg runs, ones labelled ready first, epics left out, with a board switch and the review room left). A lane with nothing in it folds to one line. Pressing h on a task opens the hand-off sheet: what the task says about its readiness, each Team with its Roles, queue and last 7 days (a team/<name> label picks the suggested Team), what handing it over does, and one button. A hand-off made there shows under Just handed over with Take back until a worker starts it. In flight and Recently ended (one row per Work Item, none for work already in a lane) stay beside the lanes. With the Fleet board on too, the Now switch reads Loop and Fleet.

metadata.title: Agent session page in two columns
metadata.description: Lays out the page of one of your agent sessions by what you do on it. A head says its state, when it was last heard, where it works, its Work Items, its API-price estimate and how to resume it. Below, wide pages put what you act on (tool prompts waiting for you, Messages, and one Hand to Ploeg card to let Ploeg finish a Work Item or start a new one) on the left, and Work Items, Telemetry, Commits and Details on the right. Narrow pages stack them in that order.

metadata.title: Run card rarity
metadata.description: Shows each Run card's rarity: how exceptional its change was, predicted once a Run starts and revealed at release, as a tier from common to legendary with its mark, frame ring, reveal and Rarity tab, and the binder's rarity filter and sort. Applies only while the deployment leaves cards.rules.rarity unset. Rarity is cosmetic: no grade, pull or Ploeg decision reads it.

metadata.title: Run health judge
metadata.description: Lets a model judge whether a running Run is still working on its Work Item, as a Ploeg Ask paid from the Team's Ask Allowance, on Hetzner's free EU-hosted inference only. Shadow only: the verdict can raise a Run's health badge, never lower it, and never stops, requeues, steers or grades a Run. Evaluated per Team: the context carries the Run's team.

metadata.title: SCIM provisioning
metadata.description: Serves the SCIM 2.0 service provider at /scim/v2 for the identity provider, with the bearer token identity.scim.tokenEnv names: Users and Groups, where a Group named unfold/<tenant>/<role> or unfold/<tenant>/client/<client> grants that membership. Deactivating or deleting a User turns the account off and ends every browser session, editor credential, Agents-window token and kept sign-in at once. While off, /scim/v2 answers 404. Evaluated for the default Tenant.

metadata.title: Shared Signals receiver
metadata.description: Accepts Security Event Tokens pushed to /ssf/events (RFC 8935) by the transmitters identity.sharedSignals lists, each verified against its JWKS, issuer, audience and jti. CAEP session-revoked, credential-change and token-claims-change and RISC account-credential-change-required end every credential of the person; RISC account-disabled and account-purged and the SCIM deactivate and delete events also turn the account off. While off, /ssf/events answers 404. Evaluated for the default Tenant.

metadata.title: Agent Trace comment on pull requests
metadata.description: Keeps one comment, keyed agent-trace, on the open pull request of a Work Item that has Linked Sessions: AI-written lines per commit from the Agent Trace records those sessions sent, with a link to each session's Unfold page. Counts and links only, never cost, model or telemetry. Written through Ploeg's keyed pull request comment at most once per five minutes per Work Item, and only when the text changed. Evaluated per Team: the context carries the Work Item's team.

metadata.title: Request intake
metadata.description: Lets senders deliver Requests to POST /api/intake/<source-id>, signed as Standard Webhooks, with a vendor signature or with a token, and lets administrators add intake sources under Settings. A webhook payload is mapped by a template; an email arrives as raw MIME or an inbound-parse JSON body and replies thread onto their Request. A Request waits for Refinement: it never becomes a Run and Unfold never writes back to the sender. Evaluated per Tenant for deliveries (the context carries tenantId) and per person for Settings.

metadata.title: Client Sign-off
metadata.description: Lets an administrator or operator record and withdraw a Client Sign-off on the Client's behalf on a Work Item's open pull request (system ADR-0049, proposed): looks good or needs changes, bound to the head commit from Ploeg's delivery facts and dismissed by a newer head. It covers the changed files minus the exclusion globs set per repository. Input to the Agency's Acceptance only: it changes no Ploeg or forge state. Evaluated per Team: the context carries the Work Item's team.

metadata.title: Client Sign-off comment on pull requests
metadata.description: Keeps one comment, keyed client-sign-off, on the open pull request of a Work Item with a Client Sign-off: the answer, the head commit and what it covers, and that the Agency decides Acceptance. It names the Client only, never the person, the note, a price or spend. Written through Ploeg's keyed pull request comment 30 seconds after a change, only when the text changed. Evaluated per Team: the context carries the Work Item's team.

metadata.title: Audit export
metadata.description: Lets a Tenant's OCSF security audit leave Unfold: as OTLP logs to UNFOLD_AUDIT_OTLP_URL, and as NDJSON from GET /api/admin/audit for the Tenant's administrators. Recording, retention and chain verification run whatever the flag says. Evaluated per Tenant: the context carries tenantId, with targetingKey tenant:<id>.

metadata.title: Tenant export
metadata.description: Lets an administrator export everything Unfold holds for a Tenant as one bundle (system ADR-0050 rule 6): a gzip-compressed tar of JSON Lines, one file per entity, a JSON Schema per entity and a manifest with row counts and SHA-256 checksums. No secrets are exported. The export runs as a background job and its download expires after 24 hours. Browser sign-in only; every start, download and deletion is logged and kept as an Action Record.

metadata.title: Bill accepted Work Items in the Agency's tool
metadata.description: Writes one line per accepted Work Item (merged, approved or silent, system ADR-0006), and one credit line per Reversal an administrator confirms, into the billing tool the billing block configures, such as Simplicate, at the Agency's own price per Client. Needs a billing block and a mapping per Client in Settings. The tool makes and sends the invoice; Unfold never does. Evaluated per Tenant: the context carries the Tenant.

metadata.title: Notifications over ntfy and Web Push
metadata.description: Lets a person choose to be told, over ntfy or Web Push, when a Work Item needs them, a question or tool permission waits for them, a pull request is ready for review, a Client Sign-off was recorded or a budget threshold was crossed (docs/operations/notifications.md). Each person opts in per channel and trigger, with optional quiet hours. Evaluated per person on the server; while it is off for a person, Unfold queues nothing for them and refuses changes to their choices. The demo sends nothing.

metadata.title: Notifications in Slack
metadata.description: Lets a person whose notifications.push flag is on link their Slack account and get their notices as Slack direct messages with an Open link (docs/operations/notifications.md#slack). With notifications.slack.permissionAnswers set, the owner of a tool-permission prompt may review and answer it from Slack after a confirmation; nothing that spends money is ever offered there. Needs a notifications.slack block with the bot token and signing secret. Evaluated per person on the server. The demo refuses a Slack block.

metadata.title: Notifications in Microsoft Teams
metadata.description: Lets a person whose notifications.push flag is on add a Power Automate Workflows webhook and get their notices as Adaptive Cards with an Open link in the Teams chat or channel that workflow posts to (docs/operations/notifications.md#microsoft-teams). The cards offer no action. Needs a notifications.teams block. Evaluated per person on the server. The demo sends nothing.

metadata.title: Decider tripwire
metadata.description: Lets Unfold's tripwire screen every new tool call of the Team's running Runs with the decider (RFC-0008): five checks scored 0 to 3, on Hetzner's free EU-hosted model through Unfold's own zero-budget gateway key, off the Run's path. Hits scoring 2 or more show on the Work Item page with right and wrong controls. Shadow only: it never stops, cancels, steers or notes a Run. Evaluated per Team: the context carries the Run's team.

metadata.title: Decider progress checks
metadata.description: Lets the decider read what the Team's running agents write (RFC-0009): each thought or message of 40 characters or more is scored 0 to 3 on three checks (thinks the work is already done, asks for a person, off the brief), and a Run no rule recognises gets a Work Kind guessed from its title. Same free EU-hosted decider, key and rate limit as the tripwire, off the Run's path. Hits scoring 2 or more are listed on the Work Item page with right and wrong controls, and a 3 on a shown check raises the Run's health to Watch; it never stops, cancels, steers or notes a Run. Evaluated per Team: the context carries the Run's team.

metadata.title: Outbound webhooks
metadata.description: Lets an administrator subscribe a URL to Unfold's product events, delivered as signed CloudEvents over Standard Webhooks from a durable outbox with retries (docs/operations/outbound-events.md). Evaluated per Tenant on the server: the context carries tenantId and a targetingKey of tenant:<id>. While it is off for a Tenant, Unfold refuses new subscriptions there and queues and sends nothing for it.
